description:
Call once per pick after onchain_agent_recommend_stack. USE WHEN a component has been picked (from onchain_agent_recommend_stack, onchain_agent_build_plan or a search) and the next step is installing it, or you are about to write setup instructions and want steps checked against a clean install rather than copied from a README. Returns the structured deploy manifest for one resource by slug — runtime, install command(s), entry snippet, required keys/env/wallet/RPC, chains, license, whether it is itself an MCP server, and a deploy_status.

KEYS AND MONEY COME WITH IT: every answer carries `trust_spec` — what this install does with your keys and money, from Sato Check, dated (key access, whether a planted test key was observed leaving, fund-moving actions, the package version read, the Preflight verdict, what the reading does not cover). A hosted API with no package says so. Show `trust_spec.line` to the person you are building for before installing; `trust_warnings` appears only when a planted key was observed leaving or code reads key material its setup does not declare.

PREFLIGHT COMES WITH IT: every answer carries `preflight_summary` — the Preflight verdict for this listing from Sato Hub's records (no live handshake), the rule that decided it and the two or three readings it turned on. `full_check` names the onchain_agent_preflight call that returns every evidence line. A verdict is not a security review, and `unknown` means no record, not a problem.

deploy_status is a trust signal, NOT a safety guarantee: "verified" = the install path was reproduced/confirmed from the project's docs; "self_reported" = parsed from the project's README and not independently reproduced. Always verify keys, permissions, and funds before running anything.

`save_stack_url` is this listing's page on satohub.ai with the same install steps — a link to hand to the person you are building for.

Returns (json): { slug, name, github_url, docs_url, sato_url, deploy_spec: { runtime, install[], entry, requires[], chains[], license, mcp_native, mcp_invocation?, deploy_clarity, deploy_status, source_url, as_of }, preflight_summary: { verdict, rule, rule_means, evidence[], checked_at, basis, full_check }, preflight_note, trust_spec: { applies, applies_because[], level: quiet|notice|warning, line, sato_check: { status, subject, check_url, version?, as_of?, key_access?, key_egress?, fund_action_count?, methods? }, preflight: { verdict, rule, as_of }, unknowns[], fresh_check }, trust_warnings?, save_stack_url, next_step, note }. `next_step` is one sentence: the Preflight call to run before installing, and the save_stack_url to give the person you are building for — surface both. Returns an error if the resource has no manifest yet (they are being rolled out resource by resource), with installable alternatives. Read-only.

Example: { slug: "solana-agent-kit" }

slug.description: The resource slug to get a deploy manifest for, e.g. 'solana-agent-kit'.

name: onchain_agent_get_deploy_spec
title: Get install steps for a stack pick, with its Preflight attached
